title: Audio Memo Narrated Event
description: The inbox watcher rendered one spoken progress update for a memo whose agent turn is still running, and uploaded it for the car (progress/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<memo_id>-<seq>.ogg in holocene-auto, never the Earshot bucket). Made from the newest bloodbank.agent.invocation.progressed of the memo's command; throttled by the watcher (none in the first ~15 s of the turn, at most one per 30 s, newest wins, none once the turn is done). Part of the voice memo journey: correlationid = data.memo_id and ordering_key 'memo:<memo_id>'. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md.

s3_key.description: Object key of the voice memo: inbox/<agent>/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<file>.

command_id.description: command_id of the turn whose progress this is.

seq.description: seq of the agent.invocation.progressed fact that was spoken (the newest one at the time).

narration.description: 1..n: how many progress updates this memo has had spoken so far, this one included.

progress_s3_key.description: Object key of the progress audio: progress/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<memo_id>-<seq>.ogg.

spoken_text.description: What was sent to TTS (agent name plus the cleaned, shortened progress line).

elapsed_seconds.description: Seconds since the memo's command was dispatched.
